messages.subject: about missing value in matchit running
messages.subject_clean: about missing value in matchit running
messages.body_plain:
Hi, all,
I want to run matchit on my computer.  Here is my code:
mout<-matchit(treat ~ Age+Gender..M.F.+stage,data=D1,method = "nearest",
distance = "logit",na.action=na.pass)
It always gave me error message:

 Missing values exist in the data


I tried with na.action and without na.action.  Both of them does not work.
I checked all the four variables in the formula, and all of them showing
that sum(is.na(D1$var))=0.  What is the problem?  Thanks everyone.

Best,

messages.body_plain:
If there are any missing values in data (i.e., D1), you will get this
error, even if they are not part of your analysis. Remove all variables
from D1 that you do not need for the matching and rerun the analysis. As
long as there are no missing values in the analysis dataset, you should not
get this error. This is a bug in MatchIt but it's easy to bypass.

Noah
